limits: All writers must use the same owner admission boundary.
Scaled 10,000-byte payload and192KiB stream budget are not measured product capacities.
One accepted task reserves two16KiB bounded final/reconcile records plus framing using conservative32KiB slots; physical stream bytes are checked against charged history.
The deliberately out-of-band full stream demonstrates explicit unavailable/no false committed rather than guaranteeing capacity under unauthorized writers.
No account-wide, disk-full, multi-task, object-store, R3, power-loss or production policy guarantee.
WSL Linux real broker only; candidate native macOS/Linux CI requires separate current-source evidence.
mutationMeaning: The copied default-bypass fixture raised the expected assertion. The negative-control driver exited0 after detecting that failure; no standalone mutant process exit is claimed.
historicalMeaning: Earlier result/log/mutation files retain older source hashes and do not qualify the final explicit-invariant candidate.
